input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium mobile slot-game currency icon
Primary request: create one independent luxury gold coin currency icon for balance, bet, and win amount indicators
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid chroma-key magenta #FF00FF background, edge to edge
Subject: one centered round gold coin medallion, front-facing with a very slight three-quarter depth, embossed pearl in the center, small diamond accents, subtle burgundy enamel rim
Style/medium: polished high-end 3D casino game UI render, soft wealthy gold, refined rather than solemn
Composition/framing: square canvas, icon fills about 78% of the canvas, complete silhouette with generous clean separation from the background
Lighting/mood: warm studio highlights, crisp metallic reflections, luminous pearl, premium and inviting
Color palette: champagne gold, ivory pearl, tiny ruby-burgundy details, clear neutral diamonds
Materials/textures: realistic polished gold, nacre pearl, faceted gemstones
Constraints: exactly one coin; symmetrical readable silhouette at 32-64 px; no text; no letters; no numbers; no extra objects; no cast shadow touching the canvas edge; no watermark
Avoid: slot reel symbol tile, cartoon flat icon, crown, wings, treasure chest, scattered coins, gradients or texture in the magenta background
